commands.title: abc: MIDI Input: Start MIDI input
commands.description: Start MIDI Input. You can also use the `Start MIDI Input` button on the right of the status bar. MIDI input device is set using `abc: MIDI Playback: Set input device` command.`

commands.title: abc: MIDI Input: Stop MIDI input
commands.description: Stop MIDI Input. You can also use the `Stop MIDI Input` button on the right of the status bar.

commands.title: abc: MIDI Input: Set input device
commands.description: Set workspace-folder specific MIDI input device for input. You can also change this manually (for more scopes) in settings under `abc › Midi Input: Input`.

commands.title: abc: MIDI Input: Write a rest
commands.description: Writes a rest (z) and selects it, so that Page Up and Page Down change its length. Bind it to a key, such as a key that a pedal sends. A MIDI control can also do it, see `abc.midiInput.controllerActions` and `abc.midiInput.restNote`.

commands.title: abc: MIDI Input: Write a bar line
commands.description: Writes a bar line after the notes that were just written.

commands.title: abc: MIDI Input: Undo the last input
commands.description: Undoes the last edit of the editor, which is the last note or rest that the input wrote, or the last change of a rhythm.

commands.title: abc: MIDI Input: toggle select input notes during midi input
commands.description: Switches `abc.midiInput.selectLatestInput`. While it is on, the notes that the MIDI input just wrote are selected, so that Page Up and Page Down can divide and multiply their length.

commands.title: abc: MIDI Input: Set the pedal mode
commands.description: Chooses how a pedal switches the MIDI input: off, hold (notes are written while the pedal is down) or toggle (each press switches the writing on or off). The choice is saved in `abc.midiInput.pedalMode`.

commands.title: abc: MIDI Input: Switch the writing of notes on and off (toggle pedal mode)
commands.description: Switches the MIDI input on and off when `abc.midiInput.pedalMode` is `toggle`. Bind it to the key that a footswitch sends, such as a Bluetooth page turner.

commands.title: abc: MIDI Input: Restart MIDI Input
commands.description: Restart MIDI Input. Try this if the input stops working after changing your MIDI Input device/port.

commands.title: ABC: Play Document
commands.description: Play the current ABC document using MuseSampler

commands.title: ABC: Play Selection
commands.description: Play the selected ABC text using MuseSampler

commands.title: ABC: Show Available Instruments
commands.description: Show list of available MuseSampler instruments

commands.title: ABC: Convert Voice Info Line to Inline
ABC: Convert Voice Inline to Info Line
ABC: Timed Explosion (Explode to Named Voices)

ABC: Halve Rhythm Length and Re-bar

abc.keyboardIsoKeys.description: Draw the keys that only ISO keyboards have (the key next to the left Shift, and the key above Enter) in the keyboard view of the select and transform menus.

abc.menu.sticky.description: Keep the select or transform menu open after a command, so that the next key runs another command. Esc closes it. With false, a command closes the menu, like a user mode of the Kakoune plugin.

abc.menuView.autoOpen.description: Open the view of the select and transform menus every time a menu opens or the mode switches. With false, open it with the command abc: Show the menu view.

enumDescriptions: In a row below the editor, as wide as the window. The editor area is split in two rows when it has one group.
In an editor column beside the current one.
In the bottom panel, which is as wide as the window. It does not open by itself: open the tab ABC keys once.
abc.menuView.location.description: Where the view of the select and transform menus lives.

abc.keymap.description: Changes to the keys of the select and transform menus. The keys "select" and "transform" each hold an object that maps a key, written in the Kakoune notation (for example "d", "<a-t>" or "<c-up>"), to a binding that is merged into the default one, or to null to remove it.

abc.keyboardLayout.description: The layout that the keyboard view of the select and transform menus draws. With bepo, the number row of the menus also reads the keys of the BÉPO layout, so that *, % and the digits of a count are the ones that the keys type.

enumDescriptions: The rows are shifted against each other, as on most keyboards.
The keys are in aligned columns.
abc.keyboardGeometry.description: The geometry that the keyboard view of the select and transform menus draws.

abc.midiInput.input.description: MIDI Device used for input. If none specified, the first valid device is used. After changing, please run the `abc: MIDI Input: Restart MIDI Input` command. You can alternatively use the command `abc: MIDI Input: Set output device` to select a device from a list.

enumDescriptions: The notes you play are always written.
The notes are written only while the pedal is down.
Each press of the pedal switches the writing of notes on or off.
abc.midiInput.pedalMode.description: Lets a pedal decide when the notes that you play are written. The pedal is a control change message on the MIDI input, the sustain pedal of a keyboard by default.

abc.midiInput.pedalController.description: The number of the control change that the pedal sends: 64 is the sustain pedal, 66 the sostenuto pedal and 67 the soft pedal.

abc.midiInput.selectLatestInput.description: Select the notes that were just written, so that a key can change their rhythm: while the MIDI input runs, Page Up divides and Page Down multiplies the length of the selected notes, as the keys of a page turner pedal send them. The next notes are still written after the selection. With VSCodeVim, the selection puts the editor in Visual mode.

abc.midiInput.restNote.description: The number of a MIDI note that writes a rest when you press it, a keyswitch of the keyboard (21 is the lowest key of an 88-key piano). Null means that no note does.

abc.midiInput.controllerActions.description: What each control change number does while the MIDI input runs. The keys are controller numbers and the values are `rest`, `barLine`, `undo` or `toggleGate`. For example, { "20": "rest", "21": "barLine", "22": "undo", "23": "toggleGate" } for a four-button footswitch. A rest and a bar line are written only while the pedal gate is open. Do not use the number of `abc.midiInput.pedalController`.

abc.midiInput.controlInput.description: The name of a second MIDI device, such as a footswitch, whose control changes work the controls above and the pedal. Empty means that the controls come on the same device as the notes. After changing, run `abc: MIDI Input: Restart MIDI Input`.

abc.midiInput.chordMode.description: Chord mode in music entry. Registers notes that are pressed and held together as a chord instead of sequential notes.

abc.midiInput.chordTimeWindow.description: When chord mode is on, the number of milliseconds to wait after a note is released before writing out the chord. Increase this if chords played on your keyboard are being split into several separate chords.

abc.midiInput.accidentals.description: Whether accidentals are written as sharps or flats when transcribing MIDI input.

abc.midiInput.relativeMode.description: Write notes in ABC relative-octave notation instead of absolute octave marks.

abc.renderer.responsive.description: Responsive rendering mode. 'resize' adapts to container width.

abc.renderer.oneSvgPerLine.description: Render each stave system as a separate SVG.

abc.renderer.tablature.description: Show tablature for the specified instrument.

abc.renderer.visualTranspose.description: Transpose the rendered score by semitones.

abc.experimental.playback.description: Enable experimental MuseSampler playback. Requires building the native binary from source. See MUSESAMPLER_SETUP.md.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run copy-jazz-midi && npm run package-bundle
scripts.build: npm run generate-keybindings && npm run check-keymap && tsc -p ./ && tsc -p webview && node esbuild.js
scripts.build:production: npm run generate-keybindings && npm run check-keymap && tsc -p ./ && tsc -p webview && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.copy-binary: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const os=require('os');const binDir='bin';const srcDir=path.join('..','native','build');const binaryName=os.platform()==='win32'?'mscore.exe':'mscore';fs.mkdirSync(binDir,{recursive:true});const src=path.join(srcDir,binaryName);const dest=path.join(binDir,binaryName);if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.copyFileSync(src,dest);fs.chmodSync(dest,0o755);console.log('Copied',binaryName,'to',binDir);}else{console.warn('Warning:',src,'not found. Build native package first.');}"
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
